newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - Norway Dec CPI seen up 0.05 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Norway Dec CPI seen up 0.05 pct m/m.

text.p: Eleven economists polled by Reuters expected Norway's consumer price index to rise by an average 0.05 percent month-on-month in December and 1.85 percent year-on-year.
The range for the month-on-month estimates was between minus 0.1 to plus 0.1 percent. The range in the estimated rise from December 1995 to December 1996 was from 1.7 percent to 1.9 percent.

December inflation figures are due on Jan 10 at 0845 GMT. NOTE - Participating institutions: Orkla Finans, Christiania Bank og Kreditkasse, Elcon Securities, Union Bank of Norway, Bergen Fonds, Fiba Nordic Securities, Handelsbanken, Unibank, Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken, Den Danske Bank, Chase Manhattan Bank.
